subject: Re: Kickoff: DP-SGD clipping library hardening
body:
Zofia,

Staffing: Umar owns the algorithmic side and the selector heuristics; Chiara does the packaging, tests, and API hardening; Leilani is on the pipeline-integration work at 40% (she's shared with another data-platforms effort this half).

Compute: day-to-day benchmarking is single-node on titan-a100. The one big ask is the full benchmark matrix — every algorithm x conv architecture x batch-size point, plus H100-specific kernels since that's where adopters will run. For that we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-01: 128 accelerators, confirmed via the Infra Lead reservation queue. One week at 128 covers the matrix with headroom for reruns.

That sequencing means benchmark-report publication lands ~June 10, after which the adoption conversations have real numbers.

Santiago
